_note: Phase 5b batch 4: ION / ION-T mounting brackets. Two products (both fit the generic `bracket` type, wired product-level): (1) ION Grille Mount holds IONBKT9 (Tahoe/Suburban grille-mount pair) on the standard whelen_ion; (2) ION-T Mount Kit holds the four universal T-Series ION mounts (universal bracket, license-plate brackets, wedges) on whelen_ion_t_hd_array. Split by ION vs ION-T so a standard-ION build doesn't see ION-T license-plate mounts. required:false. friendly_name + vehicle_tags per convention; the T-Series mounts are vehicle-agnostic so ['any'].
